profile.headline: Staff  System Integrated Software Engineer  at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary:
BSEE with 15+ years of extensive experience in software test development, hardware design and 
Integration of complex ATE Test Systems, from concept to fully operational status.

Extensive experience in working with COTS equipment from major Test and Measurement equipment.
Instrument driver software development, Automatic test software application in NI Lab Windows/CVI-
 Test Stand for Video, EO, RF, Microwave modules and CCA Functional Testing.

System level, performance verification & validation test software development for Teradyne Ultra Flex Instruments in IG-XL & Maintenance Environment.
Design and integrate automatic test station for HALT, HASS, and high altitude for electronic modules and Circuit Cards Assemblies testing.

positions.title: Staff System Integrated Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Missile Fire Control Division, Orlando, FL
positions.description: Staff System Integration Test Engineer, Lock Heed Martin’s L.M-START Test System TPS development.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed IVI Instruments driver for Video Instrument in NI Lab window CVI.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software developing and mentoring for EOTS and JSF System Integrated Test Engineers in 
NI Test Stand, NI Lab Window CVI and LM-STAR TPS program development. 
Designed and developed Test Program Set for LRC and Depot Harmonization for LM-STAR platform.

positions.title: Sr Test Designed Engineer
positions.description:
Worked in all phases of testing RF and Microwave modules and circuit card assemblies life cycles
   o Develop Functional and ESS automatic test program in NI TestStand, LabWindow CVI 
      and C language.
   o Completely design and build Environment Stress test stations, 
   o Design Fixture Interface Test Assemblies with Cadence schematic capture.
   o Provide test process and training support documents for manufacturing test floor.
   o Improving and supporting HALT & HASS and High Potential altitude tests program

positions.title: Lead Test Development Engineer
positions.description:
Led Instrument option Test Development Engineer team in:
        o	Design and develop IG-XL test software application for Flex and Ultra Flex DC
                  instruments Option. 
        o	Design Interface Test Assembly, provide test process & support document packages.
        o	 Train test systems engineering, participate in root-cause analysis, 
                    quality improvement teams, engineering change orders
        o	 Extensive participation in New Product Introduction on designed verification &
                   validation..

positions.title: Field Application Engineer
positions.description:
Provide application software for customers and support Teradyne Sale Engineer for North East Region.
Teaching In-circuit test programs for Teradyne Z-8800 series.
